Michigan student confronts El-Sayed over Iran stance in tense exchange: ‘Do you stand with us?’. A Persian student confronted Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed over leaked audio about Iran's Khamenei and his silence on the IRGC.

Trump likely ‘smirked’ as 'crass' Iranian president lashed out at US in UN speech: expert. Masoud Pezeshkian accused the U.S. and Israel of attacking Iran at the United Nations, and an expert says Trump likely responded with a smirk.

Tylenol murders mystery deepens after sheriff’s office solves decades-old ‘Unknown Wanderer’ cold case. A man who died in 1982 of cyanide poisoning in an Idaho church has been identified, raising questions about the Chicago Tylenol murders.

Blue Jays' Vladimir Guerrero Jr. says his $500M contract was for past performance – not future results. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. said his $500 million Blue Jays contract was based on past performance, sparking fan backlash amid a career-worst season.

Just one small serving of ultra-processed food a day linked to higher disease risk, major study finds. A study of nearly 8.8 million adults links every extra 100 grams of ultra-processed foods daily to higher risks of cardiovascular disease and cancer.

'Home Improvement' star Jonathan Taylor Thomas arrested for alleged public intoxication, resisting deputy. Former "Home Improvement" child star Jonathan Taylor Thomas was detained in Westlake Village, California, after reportedly exiting a vehicle.

Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur backs Marvin Harrison Jr as viral videos fuel questions about receiver's effort. Marvin Harrison Jr. has just one catch through two games as clips questioning his effort fuel criticism of the Arizona Cardinals' third-year wideout.

Bessent reveals extension to Busan agreement with China until January. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent outlines three ways the Iran war could end while warning Tehran is a "cornered animal" running out of options.

Local Virginia GOP chair says Arlington County officials prioritize illegal immigrants over public safety. Arlington County's sanctuary policies face sharp criticism in a House Judiciary Committee report over its limits on federal immigration enforcement.

Sharp weapon discovered by TSA tucked inside unusual item in passenger's carry-on bag. A pocketknife hidden inside a flight passenger's toothpaste tube in a bag was flagged during X-ray screening at Dallas Love Field after a TSA officer spotted a metal object.

Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House. A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

Venezuela's acting leader promises elections at the 'right moment'. Venezuela's acting president, delivering her first address to the U.N. General Assembly since coming to power, promised elections and said the nation's people will determine the "right moment."

OpenAI's breach of Australian health department website prompts rebuke. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said he was extremely concerned about OpenAI 's breach of an Australian health department website that the artificial intelligence company took too long to reveal.
Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region. Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii. Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.

Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban. Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.
Trump and Xi meet at moment of global consequence. It is the second time the leaders are meeting this year after the Beijing summit in May.
